newsitem.title: USA: Government Technology wins army contract.
newsitem.headline: Government Technology wins army contract.

text.p: Government Technology Services Inc. said Thursday that it and another company have won a contract to provide computers to the Army worth up to $236.7 million.
Under the contract, GTSI will provide commercial, off-the-shelf portable computers to the Army and other defence agencies over the next two years, the company said.
GTSI, a government reseller of microcomputer and Unix products, currently sells notebook computers to the Army under a contract that expires in January 1997.
